mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hp_task_exec_push(exec_id, channel_id, artifact_key, msg_type, status, sent_at) VALUES (#{execId}, #{channelId}, #{artifactKey}, #{msgType}, 'SUCCESS', NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'SUCCESS', error_code = NULL, error_msg = NULL, sent_at = NOW(3), retry_count = retry_count

INSERT INTO hp_task_exec_push(exec_id, channel_id, artifact_key, msg_type, status, error_code, error_msg, sent_at, retry_count) VALUES (#{execId}, #{channelId}, #{artifactKey}, #{msgType}, 'FAILED', #{errorCode}, #{errorMsg}, NOW(3), #{retryIncrement}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'FAILED', error_code = VALUES(error_code), error_msg = VALUES(error_msg), sent_at = NOW(3), retry_count = retry_count + #{retryIncrement}
